question: Is there anything that Priscilla-sama remembers most about her time with Abel?　If so, please let us know!
answer: I think it’s “Board game Shatranji”. They are siblings who understand each other so well that when they move a piece, they know in their minds how the other will move the next piece. So I think it often happens that they would just sit down across the board and surrender without moving a single piece, then play out their impressions of the game without a care in the world, while the people around them would be surprised.
